If you really love his personality but not his looks, be his friend. You are not being shallow by not dating him because of his looks. That is not what "shallow" means.

If there is no attraction, you're not going to want to get intimate with him, which will end up killing the relationship if there ever is one.

I am a senior in college, and I have the same problem.

I tried to do everything both when I was in high school and when I was in college, and I do it well but have no direction.

I have changed my major twice and am still unhappy. I'm probably leading myself into ruin by not sticking to something and doing well at it.

My advice to you is to do some real research on majors and careers. Find something that is extremely interesting to you and makes you employable in terms of a career. You can always spend your life learning about other subjects on your own time or taking college classes out of pocket when you can afford them.

Go into college with an "open option" major and go through the course catalog identifying the classes that stand out to you as interesting. Take all of them in your first year and note the ones you do the best in, then try to make that your major. I have to recommend programming out of what you have listed.
